"""Freeze actual native artifacts and the finite prospective calibration."""
from pathlib import Path
import hashlib
import json

task = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
repo = task.parents[2]
work = task / 'policy'


def read(path):
    return json.loads(path.read_text())


def sha(path):
    return hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()


def clean(text):
    for original, replacement in ((str(task), '<task>'), (str(repo), '<repo>'),
                                  (str(task.relative_to(repo)), '<task>'),
                                  ('/'+'projectnb/welfgr/fereg/runs/cmg-upgrade-20261021', '<scc-task>')):
        text = text.replace(original, replacement)
    return text


source = read(task / 'policy-source.json')
plans = {platform: read(work / f'plan-{platform}.json') for platform in ('Darwin', 'Linux')}
for key in ('execution_sources', 'threads', 'blocks', 'shards', 'replicas', 'seed',
            'timeout_s', 'budget_s', 'scope', 'coverage', 'diagnostic', 'warmups'):
    assert plans['Darwin'][key] == plans['Linux'][key], key
assert len(plans['Darwin']['cases']) == len(plans['Linux']['cases']) == 32
assert plans['Darwin']['mac_cell_policy']['new_call_cap'] == 864
assert plans['Darwin']['mac_cell_policy']['max_cell_retries'] == plans['Darwin']['mac_cell_policy']['max_retry_cells'] == 0
for name, digest in plans['Darwin']['files'].items():
    if name.startswith('inputs/'):
        assert plans['Linux']['files'][name] == digest
        assert sha(work / name) == digest
plugins = {'Darwin': task/'artifacts/Darwin/policy-calibration.plugin',
           'Linux': work/'linux-build/fereg_linux.plugin'}
for platform, plan in plans.items():
    assert len({arm['revision'] for arm in plan['artifacts'].values()}) == 1
    assert all(arm['revision'] == source['fereg'] for arm in plan['artifacts'].values())
    assert {plan['files'][arm['path']] for arm in plan['artifacts'].values()} == {sha(plugins[platform])}

prior = read(repo / 'bench/results/two-fe-policy-development-20261021.json')
already = {check['label'] for check in prior['checks']}
records = []
for path in sorted((task/'setup1-review/checks').glob('policy-*.json')):
    check = read(path)
    if check['label'] in already:
        continue
    assert sha(path.with_suffix('.log')) == check['log_sha256']
    record = {key: check[key] for key in ('label', 'exit', 'elapsed_s', 'log_sha256', 'environment')}
    record['command'] = [clean(item) for item in check['command']]
    record['head'] = check['before']['head'].strip()
    record['source_before_sha256'] = check['before'].get('source_vector_sha256')
    record['source_after_sha256'] = check['after'].get('source_vector_sha256')
    assert record['source_before_sha256'] == record['source_after_sha256']
    if record['exit']:
        assert record['label'] in ('policy-native-stata-1', 'policy-linux-build-inspect-1')
        record['diagnosis'] = ('The runner requires the platform filename fereg_macos.plugin. '
                               'It refused the alias before starting Stata. The exact same bytes '
                               'at the source-build path passed all six fixtures.' if record['label'] == 'policy-native-stata-1'
                               else 'Read-only status check attempted to read the build log while the job was still queued. No build or measurement failure.')
    records.append(record)

accounting = {}
for line in (work/'linux-build/qacct.txt').read_text().splitlines():
    pair = line.split(None, 1)
    if len(pair) == 2:
        accounting[pair[0]] = pair[1].strip()
assert accounting['jobnumber'] == '8243812'
assert accounting['failed'].split()[0] == accounting['exit_status'] == '0'
accounting = {key: accounting[key] for key in ('jobnumber', 'hostname', 'qname', 'project',
              'granted_pe', 'slots', 'start_time', 'end_time', 'failed', 'exit_status', 'ru_wallclock', 'maxvmem')}
accounting['raw_sha256'] = sha(work/'linux-build/qacct.txt')
replay = read(work/'native-replay/summary.json')
assert replay['passed'] and len(replay['cases']) == replay['scientific_pass_cases'] == 73
assert sum(len(row['thread_checks']) for row in replay['cases']) == 146
assert not any(row['exact_differences'] for row in replay['cases'])
stata = read(work/'stata/summary.json')
assert stata['completed'] and stata['tests_passed'] == 6 and stata['tests_failed'] == 0
breaks = {}
for label in ('builder', 'explicit'):
    raw = read(work/f'stata/break-{label}.json')
    assert raw['status'] == 'passed' and not raw['capture_errors'] and not raw['cleanup_errors']
    breaks[label] = {key: raw[key] for key in ('status', 'plugin_sha256', 'fixture_sha256',
                    'runner_sha256', 'process_returncode', 'files', 'capture_errors', 'cleanup_errors')}
    breaks[label]['record_sha256'] = sha(work/f'stata/break-{label}.json')
    breaks[label]['scope'] = ('Actual optional builder, W4, two cancellations and follow-up fits'
                             if label == 'builder' else 'Explicit sampled CMG count1/seed0; native pre-preparation cancellation and post-plugin publication interruption')

panel = read(work/'inputs/panel.json')
record = {
    'schema': 1, 'date': '2026-10-22',
    'purpose': 'Prospective frozen calibration and completed native integration for the single reviewed remaining-cost formulation. No calibration observations collected at this freeze.',
    'specification': 'docs/two_fe_auto_policy.md',
    'source': source,
    'native_artifacts': {platform: {'sha256': sha(path), 'bytes': path.stat().st_size} for platform,path in plugins.items()},
    'linux_build': {'accounting': accounting, 'build_log_sha256': sha(work/'linux-build/build.log'),
                    'checks': ['binary audit', 'actual plugin ABI/load/self-test and injected panic containment', 'numeric batch guards'],
                    'collected_plugin_rehashed_locally': True},
    'mac_build': {'checks': ['universal binary audit', 'actual arm64 plugin ABI/load/self-test and injected panic containment'],
                  'reused_timing_harness': 'Actual existing binary rehashed against accepted plan; C source, build script and header unchanged.'},
    'checks': records,
    'native_replay': {'summary_sha256': sha(work/'native-replay/summary.json'), 'result': replay},
    'stata': {'summary_sha256': sha(work/'stata/summary.json'), 'result': stata, 'break_checks': breaks},
    'input_preparation': {'panel_sha256': sha(work/'inputs/panel.json'), 'panel': panel},
    'plans': {platform: {'raw_sha256': sha(work/f'plan-{platform}.json'), 'plan': plan} for platform,plan in plans.items()},
    'fixed_budget': {'platforms': 2, 'inputs': 16, 'memory_cases': 32, 'workers': [1,4,8],
                     'controls': ['never','force16','force32'], 'retained_warmups_per_control_cell': 1,
                     'recorded_executions_per_control_cell': 2, 'calls_per_platform': 864,
                     'total_calls': 1728, 'call_timeout_s': 120, 'platform_timeout_s': 14400,
                     'retries': 0, 'continuation': False},
    'isolation': {'Linux': 'One verified whole physical 28-core SCC host, omp28 with num_proc28, all-queue reservation/census and CPU affinity checks; no competing compute.',
                  'Darwin': 'Active desktop; ordinary OS activity retained, maintained process observer. No root/agent builds, tests, estimation or other host tool workloads during measurements.',
                  'separate_host_work': 'Independent analysis or observation on separate infrastructure may continue without touching measured artifacts.'},
    'independent_freeze_review': {'result': 'No blocker found', 'bound_files_verified': 108,
                                 'input_preparation_source_hashes_verified': 242,
                                 'execution_modules_verified': 19,
                                 'scope': 'All actual Mac case headers/bodies, Fast/Low identity, independent references, seed streams, control/plugin/source bindings and finite schedule. Root additionally verified Linux source/inputs/timing harness and common execution/full-input bindings.',
                                 'limits': 'Preparation consistency does not establish calibrated support, prediction accuracy, numerical results or performance.'},
    'operations': [
        {'action': 'Deploy committed source and submit SCC native build', 'job_id': 8243812, 'exit': 0, 'log_sha256': None,
         'evidence': 'Direct tool trace; actual archive verified before extraction, complete source vector verified before and after build, scheduler accounting and build log retained above.'},
        {'action': 'Transfer frozen inputs and independent references', 'exit': 0, 'log_sha256': None,
         'evidence': 'Direct tool trace; every panel file was rehashed on Linux before plan preparation.'},
        {'action': 'Prepare Linux plan', 'exit': 0, 'log_sha256': sha(work/'plan-Linux.log')},
        {'action': 'Read-only cross-plan metadata comparison', 'exit': 1, 'log_sha256': None,
         'evidence': 'Two tool-trace-only reads requested nonexistent sources key. Corrected reads used execution_sources and passed common bindings; no source, input, artifact, plan or observation changed.'},
        {'action': 'Read-only SCC build inspection', 'exit': 0,
         'evidence': 'An unfiltered qstat produced unrelated scheduler output. Only this task job was selected for the summary; later checks used qstat -u. No job change.'},
        {'action': 'Compact protocol retention', 'exit': 1, 'log_sha256': None,
         'evidence': 'Parser initially retained qacct trailing whitespace and failed the job ID assertion before writing. Stripping whitespace matched the already validated original accounting; no observation or execution changed.'}
    ],
    'hygiene': read(work/'mac-build-cleanup.json'),
    'limits': ['Public two-FE Auto remains disabled; predictive CALIBRATION remains None.',
               'The standard installed-plugin binding remains failed; distribution packages are untouched.',
               'The native replay covers existing public/explicit paths; forced successor numerical changes will be checked against independent references in every calibration call.',
               'Command elapsed durations are not performance observations. Calibration counters and economic labels do not qualify the public policy.',
               'Paths within embedded plans/commands describe execution inputs, not retained ignored-file evidence. Compact records, hashes and committed source are the retained evidence.',
               'No calibrated coefficient, general speedup, convergence guarantee or activation follows from preparation. Held-out validation and the separate fixed42-cell round remain required.']
}
script = Path(__file__).read_text()
record['retention_tool'] = {'sha256': hashlib.sha256(script.encode()).hexdigest(), 'source': script}
text = clean(json.dumps(record, indent=2, sort_keys=True))+'\n'
for name in ('Users/', 'projectnb/', 'usr2/', 'usr4/', 'private/var/', 'var/folders/'):
    assert '/' + name not in text, name
assert len(text.encode()) < 1_000_000
path = repo / 'bench/results/two-fe-policy-calibration-20261022.json'
path.write_text(text)
print(path.name, len(text.encode()), sha(path))
